title: Monotropein synergizes with methotrexate to attenuate synovial inflammation in adjuvant-induced arthritis mice and fibroblast-like synoviocyte via GSK-3beta.
authors: Shen, Yi; Bao, Rong-Hua; Ren, Qiu-Ru; Sun, Yi-Qi; Liu, Yu-Ling; Ye, Xin-Yuan; Du, Jin-Man; Ye, Tian-Wen; Zhang, Quan-Long; Wu, Yan-Bin; Qin, Lu-Ping; Zhang, Qiao-Yan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然产物MON与甲氨蝶呤联用治疗类风湿关节炎的机制，虽涉及分子对接但核心是GSK-3beta信号通路与炎症，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Methotrexate (MTX) is the preferred drug for the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis (RA), but the toxic effects of long-term use limited its widespread clinical practice. The combination therapy of MTX with natural products is an effective strategy to reduce the toxic effects of MTX and enhance the therapeutic efficacy. Monotropein (MON), an iridoid glycosides, has potential therapeutic effects in inflammatory bone loss and osteoarthritis, and liver injury caused by MTX. However, whether MON can increase the therapeutic effects of MTX on RA and the related mechanism is not clear. PURPOSE: This study aimed to clarify the MON enhancement on MTX in the treatment of RA, and also explore the target and mechanism of MON in anti-RA. METHODS: The adjuvant-induced arthritis (AA) mice and RA-fibroblast-like synoviocytes (RA-FLSs) were used to evaluate the alleviating effects of MON, MTX and their combination on RA. The network pharmacology analysis, molecular docking and surface plasmon resonance (SPR) were utilized to predict the potential therapeutic targets and mechanism of MON on RA. The interference RNA was used to knockdown the target gene in TNF-alpha-stimulated FLSs and AA mice to validate the mechanism of MON on RA. RESULTS: MON synergizes with MTX to suppress synovial inflammation in AA mice and inhibit TNF-alpha-induced FLSs proliferation, migration, inflammatory factors production, as well as the activation of NF-kappaB and JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathways. Network pharmacology predicted GSK-3beta as a potential target of MON, and the molecular docking, CETSA, and SPR assays exhibited that MON had a good affinity with GSK-3beta. Furthermore, GSK-3beta knockdown suppressed TNF-alpha-induced FLSs proliferation, migration, matrix metalloproteinase 2 (MMP2) and MMP3 expression, and the activation of NF-kappaB and STAT3 signaling, while MON lost its inhibitory effects in GSK-3beta knockdown FLSs. In addition, joint tissue-specific GSK-3beta knockdown in AA mice alleviated synovial inflammation, decreased paw swelling and arthritis score, suppressed the phosphorylation of p65 and STAT3 of joint tissue in AA mice, while MON lost efficacy in GSK-3beta-knockdown mice. CONCLUSION: MON synergizes with MTX to inhibit synovial inflammation in AA mice and RA-FLSs inflammation by targeting GSK-3beta to suppress NF-kappaB and STAT3 pathways.
abstract_zh: 背景：甲氨蝶呤（MTX）是治疗类风湿关节炎（RA）的首选药物，但长期使用的毒性作用限制了其广泛的临床应用。将MTX与天然产物联合治疗是降低MTX毒性作用并增强疗效的有效策略。单萜苷（MON）是一种环烯醚萜苷，在炎症性骨丢失、骨关节炎以及MTX引起的肝损伤中具有潜在的治疗作用。然而，MON是否能增强MTX对RA的治疗效果及其相关机制尚不清楚。目的：本研究旨在阐明MON增强MTX治疗RA的作用，并探讨MON抗RA的靶点及机制。方法：采用佐剂诱导的关节炎（AA）小鼠和RA成纤维样滑膜细胞（RA-FLSs）评估MON、MTX及其联合用药对RA的缓解作用。利用网络药理学分析、分子对接和表面等离子体共振（SPR）预测MON对RA的潜在治疗靶点及机制。使用干扰RNA在TNF-α刺激的FLSs和AA小鼠中敲低靶基因，以验证MON对RA的作用机制。结果：MON与MTX协同抑制AA小鼠的滑膜炎症，并抑制TNF-α诱导的FLSs增殖、迁移、炎症因子产生，以及NF-κB和JAK2/STAT3信号通路的激活。网络药理学预测GSK-3β为MON的潜在靶点，分子对接、CETSA和SPR实验表明MON与GSK-3β具有良好的亲和力。此外，GSK-3β敲低抑制了TNF-α诱导的FLSs增殖、迁移、基质金属蛋白酶2（MMP2）和MMP3表达，以及NF-κB和STAT3信号的激活，而MON在GSK-3β敲低的FLSs中失去了其抑制作用。另外，在AA小鼠中关节组织特异性敲低GSK-3β减轻了滑膜炎症，降低了爪肿胀和关节炎评分，抑制了AA小鼠关节组织中p65和STAT3的磷酸化，而MON在GSK-3β敲低小鼠中失去了疗效。结论：MON通过靶向GSK-3β抑制NF-κB和STAT3通路，与MTX协同抑制AA小鼠的滑膜炎症和RA-FLSs的炎症反应。
